---
title: "{{title}}"
params:
  id: "{{id}}"
---

```{r setup}
library(fhperf)
built <- readRDS(file.path(if (file.exists("_data/indicators.rds")) "." else "..", "_data", "indicators.rds"))
id <- params$id
m <- get_indicator(built$catalogue, id)
x <- built$indicators[[id]]
s <- built$summaries[built$summaries$id == id, ]
parts <- built$parts[[id]]   # numerator and denominator series, or NULL for a count
part_title <- function(role) paste0(tools::toTitleCase(role), ": ", attr(parts[[role]]$series, "indicator")$title, " (", m[[role]], ")")
```

`r m$description`

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SPC

```{r chart}
#| fig-alt: !expr paste("SPC chart of", m$title)
plot_indicator(x)
```

```{r chart-parts}
#| eval: !expr length(parts) > 0
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-alt: "SPC charts of the numerator and the denominator"
for (role in names(parts)) print(plot_indicator(parts[[role]]$series, main_title = part_title(role), point_size = 1.8))
```

## By financial year

```{r seasons}
#| fig-alt: !expr paste("One line per financial year, April to March, for", m$title)
plot_indicator_seasons(x)
```

```{r seasons-parts}
#| eval: !expr length(parts) > 0
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-alt: "Financial year charts of the numerator and the denominator"
for (role in names(parts)) print(plot_indicator_seasons(parts[[role]]$series) + ggplot2::labs(title = part_title(role)))
```

## 6-12

```{r sixtwelve}
#| fig-alt: !expr paste("The last six weeks and twelve months of", m$title, "against a year earlier")
plot_six_twelve(built$six_twelve[[id]])
```

```{r sixtwelve-parts}
#| eval: !expr length(parts) > 0
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-alt: "6-12 charts of the numerator and the denominator"
for (role in names(parts)) {
  six <- parts[[role]]$six_twelve
  six$indicator$title <- part_title(role)
  print(plot_six_twelve(six))
}
```

:::

## Latest period

```{r latest}
latest <- data.frame(
  Period = format(s$period, "%B %Y"),
  Value = format_value(s$value, m),
  Mean = format_value(s$mean, m),
  Variation = gsub("_", " ", s$variation),
  Target = if (is.na(s$target)) "none" else format_value(s$target, m),
  Assurance = if (is.na(s$assurance)) "n/a" else s$assurance,
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(latest)
```
:::

## Breakdowns

```{r breakdowns}
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4
bd <- built$breakdowns[[id]]
if (length(bd) == 0) {
  cat("No breakdown is defined for this indicator: its components share no dimension.\n")
} else {
  cat("Each tab splits the indicator by one dimension. The table shows every group's latest point with its ",
      "plot-the-dots variation and assurance icons, largest group first; pick a group to see its charts. ",
      "Groups averaging fewer than ", built$min_per_period, " events a period are folded into one 'Other' group.\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("::::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  for (dim in names(bd)) {
    x <- bd[[dim]]
    s <- built$breakdown_summaries[[id]][[dim]]
    dim_title <- attr(x, "dimension")$title
    box <- paste0("bd-", id, "-", dim)
    cat("### ", dim_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(":::: {.breakdown #", box, "}\n\n", sep = "")
    # summary table
    cat('<table class="table table-sm breakdown-table">\n<thead><tr><th>', dim_title,
        '</th><th class="num">Latest</th><th class="num">Value</th><th class="num">Mean</th><th>Variation</th><th>Assurance</th><th class="num">',
        if (m$type == "count") "Events" else "Denominator", '</th></tr></thead>\n<tbody>\n', sep = "")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
      cat(sprintf('<tr data-group="%s"><td>%s</td><td class="num">%s</td><td class="num">%s</td><td class="num">%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td class="num">%s</td></tr>\n',
        s$group[i], s$label[i], format(s$period[i], "%b %Y"), format_value(s$value[i], m), format_value(s$mean[i], m),
        ptd_icon_svg(s$variation_icon[i], "variation"), ptd_icon_svg(s$assurance_icon[i], "assurance"),
        formatC(s$size[i], format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")))
    }
    cat("</tbody>\n</table>\n\n")
    # group selector and one chart block per group
    cat('<label class="group-label">Show charts for <select class="form-select form-select-sm group-select">\n')
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) cat(sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>\n', s$group[i], s$label[i]))
    cat("</select></label>\n\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
      g <- group_series(x, s$group[i])
      cat("::: {.group-chart", if (i == 1) " .active", " group=\"", s$group[i], "\"}\n\n", sep = "")
      cat("#### ", s$label[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
      cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n##### SPC\n\n")
      print(plot_indicator(g))
      cat("\n\n##### By financial year\n\n")
      print(plot_indicator_seasons(g))
      six_g <- built$six_twelve_breakdowns[[id]][[dim]][[s$group[i]]]
      if (!is.null(six_g)) {
        cat("\n\n##### 6-12\n\n")
        print(plot_six_twelve(six_g))
      }
      cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
      cat(":::\n\n")
    }
    cat("::::\n\n")
  }
  cat(":::::\n\n")
}
```

## Definition

```{r definition}
#| results: asis
cat("- **Id:** `", id, "` (domain `", id_domain(id), "`, ", built$catalogue$domains[[id_domain(id)]]$title, ") &middot; [YAML](../yaml.qmd#yaml-", id, ")\n", sep = "")
cat("- **Type:** ", m$type, if (m$type != "count") paste0(" (× ", format(m$multiplier), if (m$divisor != 1) paste0(" ÷ ", format(m$divisor)), ")"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- **Grain:** ", m$grain, "\n", sep = "")
cat("- **Improvement direction:** ", m$improvement_direction, "\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(m$target)) cat("- **Target:** ", format_value(m$target, m), "\n", sep = "")
comps <- indicator_components(m)
for (role in names(comps)) {
  comp <- get_component(built$catalogue, comps[[role]])
  label <- if (comps[[role]] == id) paste0(tools::toTitleCase(role), " (itself)") else tools::toTitleCase(role)
  cat("\n### ", label, ": ", comp$title, " {#", comps[[role]], "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("`", comp$id, "` · ", comp$aggregate, if (!is.null(comp$unit)) paste0(" of ", comp$unit), " · source `", comp$source, "` · [YAML](../yaml.qmd#yaml-", comp$id, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(comp$description, "\n\n")
  cat("```sql\n", component_sql(built$catalogue, comp$id), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Data

```{r data}
tab <- as.data.frame(x)
tab$period <- format(tab$period, "%b %Y")
tab$value <- format_value(tab$value, m)
tab$numerator <- formatC(tab$numerator, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
tab$denominator <- if (m$type == "count") NULL else formatC(tab$denominator, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
names(tab) <- tools::toTitleCase(names(tab))
knitr::kable(tab[nrow(tab):1, ], row.names = FALSE, align = "r")
```
